title: Point of sale
subtitle: Scan, tap or search products — the cart is saved as you go.
shortcuts: Shortcuts: / focus search · ↑ ↓ move highlight · Enter add highlighted product · F2 pay · barcode scanner works anywhere on this screen

search.placeholder: Search products by name, SKU or barcode…
search.noResultsHint: Try another search, scan the barcode, or add a free-text line.

camera.title: Scan with camera
camera.hint: Hold the barcode inside the frame — it is added to the cart automatically.
camera.denied: Camera access was blocked. Allow the camera in the browser settings and try again.
camera.notFound: No camera was found on this device.
camera.failed: The camera could not be started. Close other apps using it and try again.

cart.title: Cart
cart.emptyHint: Scan a barcode, tap a product, or add labour or a free-text line.
cart.voidMessage: Sale {{number}} ({{amount}}) will be voided. Nothing has been charged yet, but the receipt number stays used.

discount.cartDescription: Applies to the whole cart ({{amount}} after line discounts).
discount.yourLimit: Your discount limit is {{pct}} % of the subtotal.
discount.limit: This exceeds your discount limit of {{pct}} % of the subtotal. Ask an admin to give the discount.

details.title: Customer & sale details
details.customerHint: Optional — leave empty for a walk-in customer.
details.customerSearch: Search customers by name, email or phone…
details.unitHint: Optional — the unit this repair or sale concerns.
details.unitSearch: Search units by code or brand…

payment.title: Payment
payment.mismatch: Payments must add up to the total ({{remaining}} difference).
payment.tenderedTooLow: Tendered cash must be at least the amount.
payment.vatDefault: VAT invoice issued (default for this receiver): {{value}}
payment.outOfStock: Not enough stock for some products

success.title: Payment received
success.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the receipt window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.

parked.title: Parked sales
parked.emptyHint: Use Park to put a cart aside and serve the next customer.
parked.voidMessage: Sale {{number}} ({{amount}}) will be voided and removed from the parked list.

refund.title: Refund
refund.notFound: Receipt {{number}} was not found among completed sales.
refund.noSales: No completed sales on this day
refund.noSalesHint: Pick another date or type the receipt number above.
refund.notRefundableHint: Only completed sales can be refunded.
refund.fullyRefunded: The sale is now fully refunded.
refund.partiallyRefunded: The sale is partially refunded — the rest can still be refunded later.
refund.restockHint: Untick for broken or unsellable items.
refund.paymentMismatch: Refund payments must add up to {{amount}}.
refund.amountAdjusted: The exact refund amount is {{amount}} — the payment rows were updated, check and submit again.
refund.selectLines: Select at least one line to refund.

toast.inactiveProduct: {{name}} is marked inactive — check the product.

errors.noModel: Business models are still loading — try again in a moment.
errors.notEditable: Sale {{number}} is no longer open for editing.
errors.nothingToPay: Add items to the cart before paying.

validation.badAmount: Enter a valid euro amount, e.g. 12,50
